segments.title: February
segments.text: Hello Kemps Corner! February. The shortest month, and the most romantic. Our theme is Red Flags, Green Flags: Valentine's, Galentine's and Singles Awareness Day, and a studio that is very much a green flag.

segments.title: ₹25.7L
segments.text: So, the number. Our February target for Kemps Corner is 25.7 lakh rupees. That's 34 per cent above last February. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 14.1 lakh rupees. That's 6 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 6.17 lakh, comebacks 3.08 lakh, and everything else 2.31 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 55 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 400 leads, 204 trials, and 55 buyers, with about 27 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.

Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 19.3 lakh rupees, which is 75 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Love Bombing (The Healthy Kind)
segments.text: First up, Love Bombing, the healthy kind. Every member writes a love letter to a friend: two free classes. If the friend joins, they get fifteen per cent off and grip socks, and the member gets five extra days. The plan is 12 buyers at about 17,200, so 2.06 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Current members bringing a never-been friend.

segments.title: Blind Date (No Catfishing)
segments.text: Next, Blind Date, no catfishing. Two mystery classes for nine ninety-nine. The format and the trainer stay sealed until you walk in. Love it, and the whole fee comes off your first month. The plan is 22 buyers at about 16,200, so 3.56 lakh rupees.

segments.title: It’s Not You, It’s Your Schedule
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, It's Not You, It's Your Schedule. They pick a relationship status: Exclusive is three months, Casual is a twelve-class pack, It's Complicated is one month with a free freeze. Fifteen per cent off whichever they choose. The plan is 10 buyers at about 17,200, so 1.72 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Put a Ring On It
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Put a Ring On It. Renew for three months and get the ring, which is a mini-band, relax. Six months comes with a private, and annual members go on the Wall of Commitment. Say yes at the desk and the bell rings. The plan is 20 buyers at about 60,000, so 12 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing in February (any expiry date).

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, blind-date envelopes at every desk, and the love letters go out to members. Week two, Galentine's and Valentine's weekend, with Partner Barre on Sunday the fourteenth. Week three, the Hate-Squat Hour for the singles, and every renewal hears Put a Ring On It. Week four, last call for lapsed members to pick their relationship status.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's February at Kemps Corner. 25.7 lakh rupees, four offers, and 55 buyers to welcome. Short month, long commitments. That's the dream.
